ModMetaData.name: Long Growth Gene
ModMetaData.author: Zoorackzoos
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the "long growth" archite gene. A pawn with the gene starts at 80% of many capacities and stats, and gains 1 percentage point of them every in-game day, eventually surpassing ordinary pawns. Hunger, sleep and recreation needs drain more slowly as it grows.
Requires Biotech and Harmony.
